messages.subject: 2 tests vs 1 control sample
parts:
Hi,
I am using methylkit to compare two test ERRBS samples against a single
control ERRBS sample. Would you recommend forcing Fisher's exact test in
this case?
Thanks,
Piali

messages.author: 38c56d0e82a34280
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] 2 tests vs 1 control sample
parts:
I think Fisher's exact test only applies when there are two samples- the contingency table at a given loci is:

[ Sample_1_Cs, Sample_1_Ts
  Sample_2_Cs. Sample_2_Ts]

You'd have to use a generalized version of Fisher's exact test to extend it to 3 or more

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] 2 tests vs 1 control sample
parts:
You can pool the 2 replicate sample together with pool() and do the fisher's exact test with calculateDiffMeth(). We don't have anything else that can be used in this case.

Best,
Altuna
